uncited: It builds on [Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) Traversal](3061-digital-differential-analyzer-dda-traversal.md) and differs from [DDA](2323-dda.md), [Two-Step Discrete Ray Tracing](5204-two-step-discrete-ray-tracing.md), [Voxel Occupancy Mask](5242-voxel-occupancy-mask.md), [Parallel 3D-DDA](6247-parallel-3d-dda.md), and [Nearest Neighbor Ray Traversal](8321-nearest-neighbor-ray-traversal.md) by halting traversal at the first sign change rather than sampling all active voxels.
